result.summary: Found 4 issues: layout cutoff on the horizontal scroll section, a category chip cut off at edge, and minor content/text truncation issues.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, showing a partial third card (Trattoria Piccol...) with truncated text, indicating the horizontal scroll container is clipped by the screen boundary without clear affordance to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-card preview with a soft fade/gradient edge or ensure consistent card width so the cutoff looks intentional and signals scrollability.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') are cut off at the right edge with an additional partially visible chip, making it unclear if more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visible chip indicator to clarify horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off due to the card being clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis consistently, or reveal more of the card so full restaurant names are visible.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon for 'Tokumaru Ramen' is white on a busy food image background, which may reduce visibility while the second heart icon (on the pizza image below) is styled with a dark circular background, showing inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background (e.g., always use a semi-transparent dark circle) across all promotional/restaurant cards for consistency and better contrast.
